lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho₂Ti₈Sn₄ (reduced formula HoTi₄Sn₂) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies Ho centers as octahedral with six Ti neighbors (2.65–2.98 Å), while Ti and Sn centers show 11- and 10-neighbor environments, respectively, with mixed Ho, Sn, and Ti coordination. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Ho octahedra and Ti and Sn coordination polyhedra, as well as corner-sharing between Ti polyhedra.
